resources.string: Choosing a border color sets the width to 1dp when it is zero. Set the width to 0 to hide the border. Background transparency does not affect the border.
Adds padding to the existing component spacing. A value of 0 adds no extra padding.
Message and component text colors take priority. The global text color overrides body text colors in the global palette.
The message background color follows the background transparency in message appearance settings. Text color is independent.
Avatar fill is drawn behind the image. An opaque avatar image covers the fill.
Sets a lower height limit. It cannot shrink a component below its native minimum height.
